    • passivePressure

      private void passivePressure(PidElement proposal, Element valve)
      Maps a canonical absolute activation pressure to the official gauge-only native property.

      No atmospheric default is assumed. Full-lift, reseat and response parameters retain their absolute canonical sidecar basis; SetPressureLow is not a reseating property.

      Parameters:
      proposal - actual passive canonical relief proposal
      valve - existing native safety-valve object
